issues.problem: Microsoft's fiscal 2025 net income was about $101.8 billion, not $127.3 billion. The stated figure is also almost as large as operating income ($128.5 billion), which isn't plausible once taxes are taken out.

data.summary: Most of the figures match what I know of Microsoft's fiscal 2025 results: revenue of $281.7 billion, up 14.9% from $245.1 billion; operating income of $128.5 billion; total assets of $619.0 billion; and cash and cash equivalents of about $30.2 billion. The exception is net income, which was about $101.8 billion, not $127.3 billion. I checked this from memory, without access to the filings.
